title: High fuel prices, peso slump ground CebuPac to P12.8-B loss

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Budget carrier Cebu Pacific sank deeper into the red in the first nine months of 2026, posting a P12.8-billion net loss after a double whammy of soaring jet fuel costs and a weakening peso. This marked a reversal from the P9.46-billion profit that the Gokongwei-led carrier booked in the same period in 2025. READ: CebuPac six-month net loss widened to P5.59 Billion The losses came despite the Gokongwei-led carrier eking out a 4-percent increase in passenger traffic to nearly 21 million from January to September, helping deliver a 10-percent revenue growth to P96.2 billion.
